quests.instruction: Listen carefully, then select the word you hear.
quests.hint: For 'then,' let your tongue rest gently between your teeth while your voice buzzes; for 'den,' tap your tongue tip against the ridge behind your teeth instead.
quests.explanation: The speaker said "then." The /ð/ is a continuous, voiced buzz with the tongue between the teeth. "Den" would use a quick, voiced tap of the tongue against the ridge instead, for /d/.
quests.vowelTensionRule: /d/ is a quick stop-and-release behind the teeth. /ð/ is a steady, continuous buzz with the tongue tip between the teeth.

quests.instruction: Listen carefully, then select the word you hear.

quests.vowelTensionRule: /ð/ lets the voice buzz continuously with the tongue between the teeth. /d/ fully stops the air behind the teeth, then releases it.
